rootCause: RenderTextConstant emits C-style escaped quotes into ordinary SLG strings, but ordinary SLG lexical quotes do not support that escape. Linux mouse LLVM globals contain quotes and trigger lex failure during atomic policy generation. Existing test checks only escaped source spelling rather than parsed exact constant value.
scope: CSharp generator issue, before any SLG runtime implementation edit; do not change language grammar or weaken output values.
